Finnaux migration batch (1/5): Don't merge feat/external-apis into dev or deploy it until the Finnaux migration + seed commit is in.

Finnaux migration batch (2/5): Use fixed-cuids.ts as the checklist. Every id under EXTERNAL_API_ENDPOINT.FINNAUX must have a row in the migration and a line in seed/data/apiEndpoints.json. Compare both lists before writing the migration.
Finnaux migration batch (3/5): Write the migration as an upsert (ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE), not DO NOTHING, so the hand-inserted local rows get brought in line.

Finnaux migration batch (4/5): Fix the '...' / '{...}' placeholders in drizzle/0008_finnaux_kyc_endpoints.sql in the same commit, using the real description and metadata from the seed file. '{...}'::jsonb breaks migrate on DBs that already have the Finnaux groups.
Finnaux migration batch (5/5): Before committing, run migrate on a DB without the hand-run rows (a copy, or a fresh DB + seed) and confirm every Finnaux endpoint appears.
